name: Hoan Kiem Lake
kicker: The lake path, with Turtle Tower in the water
summary: Start here. Walk the free path around Hoan Kiem Lake, with Turtle Tower standing in the water and willows on the shore, then cross the red The Huc bridge if you want Ngoc Son Temple on the island. Come early, when people exercise and practise tai chi along the path.
fee: Lake path free. Temple ticket separate.
getThere: Walk from the lanes north of the lake
heroCaption: Turtle Tower in Hoan Kiem Lake

notice.title: The path and the temple are different tickets
notice.body: The lake path is free and open all day. Ngoc Son Temple, on the island, charges its own ticket.

body: Walk the shore. Turtle Tower stands in the lake, and the willows line the near bank. The path is free and open all day. At dawn it fills with people exercising and practising tai chi.

Ngoc Son Temple sits on the island, reached by the red The Huc bridge. Nguyen Van Sieu renovated it in 1864, the bridge name means where the morning sun rests, and the temple worships Tran Hung Dao and Van Xuong. It is the one ticketed stop on the walk.
Walk the full loop first, then decide on the temple. On weekend evenings the temple stays open until 22:00.

figures.alt: Willow trees along the shore of Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi

gettingThere: The lake is the center of the city walk. Start from the Old Quarter lanes just north of it, or from the Opera House streets to the south.

legs.heading: From the lanes north of the lake
legs.body: Walk south to the shore. The path is free.

legs.heading: From south of the lake
legs.body: Walk north from Trang Tien to the shore.

hours: Lake path: open all day (Vietnam Tourism). Ngoc Son Temple: Mon–Thu 7:00–19:00, Fri–Sun and holidays 7:00–22:00 (management board); Mon–Fri 7:00–18:00, Sat–Sun 7:00–22:00 (Vietnam Tourism).
admissionNote: Lake path free. Ngoc Son Temple: adult 50,000 VND (management board from 1 January 2024, and Vietnam Tourism); half price 25,000 VND; under 16 free.
